question.text: The conformations of $n$ -butane, commonly known as eclipsed, gauche and anti-conformations can be interconverted by

options.text: rotation around $C-H$ bond of a methyl group
rotation around $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{H}$ bond of a methylene group

solution.text: The conformation of $n$ -butane, commonly known as eclipsed, gauche and anti-conformations can be interconverted by rotation around C2-C3 linkage. Hence, the option (d) is correct answer.
